title: Continuous algebraic p-adic representations have finite models
statement: Let ell be prime, let G be any profinite group and let V be a finite-dimensional vector space over PadicAlgCl ell [def-pod-l-adic-representations]. Let rho be a group homomorphism to linear automorphisms. Assume that g maps to f(rho(g)(v)) is continuous for every linear functional f and vector v. Then Representation.IsLAdic holds: there is a finite intermediate field E, an actual G-invariant E-submodule W of V with continuous finite-dimensional action and the canonical scalar-extension equivalence sending each pure tensor a ⊗ w to a • w, for a in PadicAlgCl ell and w in W. The zero-dimensional case is included.

proof.text: Choose a finite basis. The dual-coordinate hypothesis makes the associated matrix homomorphism continuous entrywise. Apply compact matrix coefficient descent to find a finite intermediate field E containing all entries.

Corestrict the matrix coefficients to E. The field embedding is a closed embedding of finite-dimensional normed Q_ell vector spaces, so the corestricted entries are continuous for the spectral topology. Injectivity of E into the closure proves the matrix group laws. The finite sums expressing matrix-vector multiplication give a jointly continuous action on the coordinate E-space. Map that coordinate space to V by the basis and take its image W. Linear independence gives an E-linear equivalence onto W; transport gives its continuous action. The finite-basis scalar-extension equivalence is canonical on pure tensors, proving the recorded IsLAdic conclusion. All sums and basis identities remain valid for the empty basis.

theorem isLAdic_of_continuous_dual_coefficients
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u})
    (V : Type v) [AddCommGroup V] [Module (PadicAlgCl l) V]
    [FiniteDimensional (PadicAlgCl l) V]
    (ρ : G →* (V ≃ₗ[PadicAlgCl l] V))
    (hρ : ∀ (f : Module.Dual (PadicAlgCl l) V) (v : V),
      Continuous fun g : G ↦ f (ρ g v)) :
    IsLAdic l (PadicAlgCl l) G V ρ
